task: Diagnose: QR connected but no auto reply
summary: Rowad Alfa WhatsApp QR / auto-reply / content-sync repair (Claude Code). ROOT CAUSES fixed: (1) replies were re-addressed from the incoming @lid chat to the phone JID (key.senderPn); Baileys 6.7.24 keys Signal sessions by address, so every phone-JID send forked the session -> next inbound 'Bad MAC' -> 6-7 s WhatsApp retry (the 'delay') -> retry lacked senderPn -> customer keyed by LID digits = second customer record -> welcome/language flow repeated ('Hello, welcome to The Business'), and eventually 'Waiting for this message' on the phone. Now: reply ALWAYS to key.remoteJid as received; customer identity = phone JID via senderPn or the new whatsapp_lid_map table (LID<->phone pairings learned from messages and contacts.upsert/update). (2) Dashboard text != WhatsApp text: menu.ts generated option lists/footers in code and preview hard-coded options. Now templates carry the full Antigravity content (61 templates: welcome/language, 9-option main menu, 4 submenus + 25 detail texts, prices/offers menu + 4 info texts, location, about, appointment 8-step flow, quotation 4-step flow, support/error texts) and are sent verbatim; option number -> action lives in src/automation/menuRouter.ts (MAIN_MENU_OPTIONS/SUBMENUS/FLOWS/FOLLOW_UP_TEMPLATES); preview endpoint uses the live renderer and returns the follow-up bubble. (3) Bot replies were not persisted in the menu path -> every inbound/outbound bubble now stored (dashboard conversations complete). (4) BUSINESS_NAME env default 'The Business' -> 'Rowad Alfa Auto Care'. (5) Stale offline-backlog messages (>10 min old) are stored as suppressed, never auto-answered. (6) Appointment/quotation requests persisted in customer_requests with APT-/INQ- references; dashboard Bookings page lists them with status control; /api/dashboard/requests, /menu-tree added; flow map rebuilt from the router tree; WhatsApp-style preview (RTL/LTR, follow-up bubble, draft/live badge). Template upgrade logic: default text refreshed, live text moved only when unmodified, retired 'welcome' removed when unmodified. Migration 012 (additive): whatsapp_lid_map, customer_requests, customers.menu_state/flow_data/reply_jid. Baileys stays 6.7.24 (Antigravity uses ^6.7.19). No Meta API. No numeric prices (zero-fabricated-pricing). Antigravity reference project untouched; its server on port 3005 left running and untouched per user instruction. NOTE: between 12:12 and 12:20 the saved Baileys session disappeared (only code path: WhatsApp loggedOut handler or dashboard Log out); user re-scanned at ~12:21; a warn log line was added to the loggedOut branch for future evidence. ROUND 3 (production-readiness): QR page — root cause of "Preparing session…" was routine 428 socket drops followed by a reconnect whose Baileys version lookup had no timeout (one 2.5-min gap observed 12:46→12:48); fixed with a 5 s cap, 1 s first reconnect, socket timeouts, 515 shown as pairing, isNewLogin → pairing state, Refresh QR Code / Refresh Status / Retry Connection actions with guards (never logout, never second socket), diagnostics (pid/port/cwd/socket generation/active sockets/owner pid/last QR & connection events) in API + UI. Business Profile and Location pages crashed because they read `s.settings` from /api/dashboard/settings (shape is {business,booking,agent,content,overrides}); new /api/dashboard/business-profile returns flat settings + rendered hours/address; both pages rebuilt as editable forms (AR/EN names, category, descriptions, address AR/EN, Google Maps link default https://maps.app.goo.gl/8sxNK9wMNsTucvCh7, lat/lng with embedded map preview, days, hours, Friday hours, notes). {maps}/{hours}/{address}/{business} placeholders now resolve from published settings per language; location_hours template rewritten to use them; AI prompt gets the same profile facts. Business documents module (business_documents table, data/uploads, allowlist ext+MIME+magic bytes, 10 MB cap, UUID storage names, HTML served as text/plain with sandbox CSP, visibility internal/ai_knowledge/customer, archive/replace/delete, text extraction for txt/md/html feeding the AI prompt). Offers module (offers table; draft/published/finished/archived + derived scheduled/expired; numeric prices stored only when price_status=verified; customer resolver listCustomerVisibleOffers used by WhatsApp {offers} (prices → 3 sends prices_offers_list or falls back to prices_offers when empty), preview, AI prompt; dashboard page with KPIs, search/filters, grid/list, edit/duplicate/publish/unpublish/finish/archive/restore/delete). Migration 013 additive. README + docs/QR_CONNECTION.md state ports (3000 ours, 3005 Antigravity). ROUND 4: {notes} placeholder + boot-time seeding of Rowad Alfa location defaults (only NULL columns; live DB already had dashboard-set values → nothing overwritten); empty placeholders no longer leave dangling labels; offer editor uploads images/documents directly; regression tests for consecutive LID messages with/without senderPn, duplicate Baileys events, history-sync append batches, cross-generation reconnect isolation; e2e sweep of all 28 GET endpoints the dashboard calls. Runtime 14:29-14:31: network-level 408 timeouts, sockets 17→22 with backoff, recovered automatically; zero Bad MAC/stubs/dups/unhandled since 12:21.
reason: User reported: delays, duplicated welcome/menus, missing customer messages, generic 'Car Audio - ask me about...' texts, dashboard preview differing from WhatsApp, only +966558190545 working.
